# Two small admitted HTTPS feeds. The live smoke runner tries them in order and
# stops after the first source that completes a real ConfigStream merge with a
# non-empty validated output. This keeps normal smoke workload to one source
# while retaining a second fallback for upstream availability.
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatinGhanbari/v2ray-configs/main/subscriptions/v2ray/subs/sub27.txt
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MatinGhanbari/v2ray-configs/main/subscriptions/v2ray/subs/sub1.txt
